Engine lagThe time an engine takes to deliver 63 % (nearly two thirds) of a new acceleration it is asked for.

  • A real engine has this lag, so our model must include it: we simulate a lag of 0.3 s (chosen).
  • Ask for the most, 3 m/s2, starting from 0: every 0.3 s, the acceleration closes 63 % of the gap still left.

time after askingtry it

So a controller that changes \(u\) sees the effect only some time later.
